generic_football_fallback_removed.before: Observation writer split fact_id string and fell back to 'football' by default if facts were empty or had underscores.
generic_football_fallback_removed.after: Observation writer queries the resolved sport name dynamically from the 'sports' table via resolution.sport_id, and returns SPORT_CONTEXT_MISSING if it cannot be proven.

default_completed_200_removed.before: source_operation_attempt status defaulted to COMPLETED and http_status to 200 before matching completeness state was proven.
default_completed_200_removed.after: source_operation_attempt status and selectable/http_status are strictly derived from matched completeness state (or set to UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE_STATE/None/selectable=0 with detailed diags if missing).

unknown_facts_safe_handling.before: UNKNOWN scope facts were copied into both home_payload and away_payload, exactly like fixture-level facts.
unknown_facts_safe_handling.after: UNKNOWN scope facts are quarantined into diagnostics['quarantined_unknown_facts'] and not written to observation payloads or included in projections (Policy A).

fixture_level_duplication_marked.before: Duplicated fixture-level facts did not have explicit projectable/selectable policies.
fixture_level_duplication_marked.after: Duplicated fixture-level facts are explicitly marked with duplicated_for_schema_team_id_constraint=true and fixture_level_projectable_policy='SELECTABLE_FIXTURE_LEVEL'.
